description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors, specifically detecting unwritable repository states and verifying that Git fails correctly under those conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion, used to setup conditions and verify outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a cleanup command to execute after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output to expected results for validation.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test timer or state to simulate passage of time or progress.
